locator: Table 1, POPC, area per lipid at 30 °C. Equation 2 describes the uncertainty.
observable: Area per POPC molecule in a fluid bilayer inferred by simultaneous small-angle neutron and X-ray scattering.
mapping: One leaflet footprint per lipid. The total bilayer area is half the sum over all lipid molecules. The structural measurement supplies the engine's input.
